description: Difficulty levels chosen in Settings. Normal plays every Event exactly as data/events.json and data/standards.json say (the parity target). Easy and Hard scale a few values: speedGain multiplies the speed gained per run press, rivalPace multiplies the Rival's top speed, standardScale makes Standards tougher above 1 and easier below 1, angleWindowWiden adds degrees to each side of every take-off and release angle window, and clearWindowWiden adds frames to each side of the hurdle clear window.
